profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA. The company's website for Power Automate describes the product as a workflow and business process automation tool that works across apps, systems, and websites using AI-powered, digital, and robotic process automation. One customer quoted on the site describes reducing a data validation process that previously required over 100 people to one manageable by just a few, using generative AI and Power Automate.

Microsoft's AI product portfolio spans several categories. Power Automate AI offers enterprise workflow automation with Copilot and Microsoft 365 data integration. Microsoft Copilot is embedded across the Microsoft 365 suite. Azure OpenAI Service provides access to OpenAI models within Azure, with enterprise content filtering, Entra ID integration, and data residency controls. Azure Machine Learning is positioned as an MLOps platform with AutoML and a responsible AI toolkit. Additional products include AutoGen, a multi-agent conversation framework developed by Microsoft Research, as well as Microsoft Designer for image and design generation, Microsoft Teams AI for meeting recaps and Copilot integration, SharePoint AI for enterprise content, and Microsoft Clipchamp AI for video editing.

On the litigation side, Microsoft is a named defendant in The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, filed in U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, and is an associated party in Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc., in the same court. Microsoft files with the SEC under CIK 0000789019 and trades on a public exchange under the ticker MSFT. The company reported revenue of $331,839,000,000 for the period ending June 30, 2026, as disclosed in a 10-K filing.
